title: Rigidity for two-phase overdetermined problems in $\mathbb{S}^n$
summary: In this paper, we study rigidity phenomena associated with a class of overdetermined two-phase problems on the $n$-dimensional sphere $\mathbb{S}^n$. Specifically, we analyze the solutions of coupled elliptic equations defined on a domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{S}^n$ and its complement, subject to Dirichlet boundary conditions on the interface $\partialΩ$ and a compatibility condition on the gradient. We utilize two different methods. The method of moving planes works when $\partialΩ$ is contained inside an open hemisphere. The other method works when $Ω$ is simply connected in $\mathbb{S}^2$.…
